subtitles.en: In the U.S. market, everybody was holding their breath on Microsoft and Amazon's revenue because if that didn't come in, there was going to be an extreme validation of the concept that maybe the AI boom was over, that we were spending too much money, that we had to hold off on capacity planning.
subtitles.zh: 在美国市场，大家都在屏息等待微软和亚马逊的营收，因为如果数据不佳，就可能印证AI热潮已过、投入过多、需要暂缓产能规划的观点。

subtitles.en: The sales there came in better than expected. The discussion about demand going forward became better than expected, which leads to really the semiconductor industry getting a boom and the whole global economy saying that there's still opportunity for AI sales as we move forward.
subtitles.zh: 实际销售好于预期，对未来需求的讨论也好于预期，这带动半导体行业景气，全球经济也认为AI销售仍有增长空间。

subtitles.en: So Maribel, part of, I guess, the second part to that question would be how much of the are they monetizing AI question that was answered so far?
subtitles.zh: 那么Maribel，第二个问题就是，AI变现的问题目前回答了多少？

subtitles.en: I think we came in better than expected. We've heard the story for several quarters now about we're going to invest, we're going to invest and then we're going to see some enterprise buying demand.
subtitles.zh: 我认为结果好于预期。过去几个季度我们一直听到要投入、再投入，然后才会看到企业采购需求的故事。

subtitles.en: So when you look at the size of the cloud services that we were going into to still see, you know, 30s, almost 40% growth in a hyperscaler at this stage of the game was actually very encouraging that the demand that they have been talking about was actually started to be monetized with people running AI workloads in the cloud.
subtitles.zh: 所以当你看到云服务的规模，超大规模云厂商在这个阶段仍有30%到近40%的增长，这非常鼓舞人心，说明他们之前谈到的需求确实开始通过人们在云端运行AI工作负载而变现。

subtitles.en: So how does this, what's the re through there, right? You mentioned that it could lift the chip sector, the picks and shovels trade and really kind of bring momentum back into this market.
subtitles.zh: 那么这如何传导呢？你提到这可能提振芯片板块，也就是卖铲子的交易，并真正为市场带来动力。

subtitles.en: Do you think that this is the beginning of some sort of relief rally now, or do you think we still might be dealing with some volatility ahead?
subtitles.zh: 你认为这是否是某种反弹的开始，还是说我们仍可能面临一些波动？

subtitles.en: I think we were chasing ghosts before, we didn't really know if there was going to be any signs of growth and opportunity moving forward. I think that the earnings that we've seen thus far this quarter actually were fairly strong across the board for almost everyone.
subtitles.zh: 我认为之前我们是在追逐幻影，并不确定未来是否有增长和机遇的迹象。而本季度迄今的财报实际上对几乎所有公司来说都相当强劲。

subtitles.en: There were some issues, for example, you mentioned Apple in terms of some of what the disappoint was, I think there's been a discussion about companies like how diversified are they? Do you have data center, do you have smartphones, do you have physical AI, do you have software and services, and depending on the answer to that question, there's more or less enthusiasm around you as a company.
subtitles.zh: 也存在一些问题，比如你提到的苹果令人失望的地方。我认为关于公司多元化程度的讨论很多：是否有数据中心、智能手机、实体AI、软件和服务，答案不同，市场对公司的热情也不同。

subtitles.en: I think what we did see is for the infrastructure, for the picks and shovels companies that are selling to the hyperscalers that are selling through to the enterprise buyers, doing AI workloads, we finally saw some light in what we thought was going to be a fairly significant quarter to just be average. An average was definitely not going to be good enough.
subtitles.zh: 我认为我们看到的是，对于向超大规模云厂商销售、再转售给企业客户的基础设施和卖铲子公司，我们终于看到了一些曙光，而此前我们认为本季度可能只是平平。但平平显然不够好。

subtitles.en: No, can I ask you about Merah, and I'm a bit hesitant to directly tie the market reaction to what the company said, because the stock is also also done well, so it could be partly related of course. I think I was checking the statistic today, here we go, stock is down 11 straight days, long since it went public back in 2012.
subtitles.zh: 我能问问你关于Meta的事吗？我有点犹豫是否直接将市场反应与公司言论挂钩，因为股价也表现不错，所以可能部分相关。我今天查了一下数据，股价已连续下跌11天，这是自2012年上市以来最长的连跌。

subtitles.en: Did anything go wrong in your view with the meta story?
subtitles.zh: 在你看来，Meta的故事出了什么问题吗？

subtitles.en: So one of the things that investors are really struggling with right now with the meta story is they're investing a lot of capital, unlike hyperscalers, they're not really going to sell a lot of cloud computing services.
subtitles.zh: 投资者目前对Meta故事的一个困扰是，他们投入了大量资本，但与超大规模云厂商不同，他们并不会出售大量云计算服务。

subtitles.en: So all of that has to be monetized with some form of AI services or advertising services, and the big unknown, and this is a very large significant unknown, is when we will start to see the impact of the AI model providers, the new AI search providers, companies like Proplexity, companies like OpenAI, who have made stated opinions about how they want to be the next wave of commerce and helping with that next wave of advertising commerce, how is that going to impact meta?
subtitles.zh: 因此所有这些都必须通过某种形式的AI服务或广告服务来变现，而最大的未知数，也是非常重要的未知数，是我们何时会开始看到AI模型提供商、新的AI搜索提供商（如Perplexity、OpenAI）的影响，他们已明确表示希望成为下一波商业和广告商业的推动者，这将如何影响Meta？

subtitles.en: We have trouble handicapping that one right now, so some of the disappointment with meta is very strong investment, and a very uncertain future revenue outlook for them in terms of who's going to be coming into their market and impacting themselves.
subtitles.zh: 我们目前很难评估这一点，所以对Meta的失望在于投入非常强劲，而未来收入前景非常不确定，因为谁将进入他们的市场并影响他们。

subtitles.en: This week there was a lot of concerns before these earnings of course, Meribault, about circular financing once again, what these hyperscalers, what Nvidia, and how they're becoming big financial players in this whole AI infrastructure build out. How concerned should we really be now about these big, big deals that are coming through?
subtitles.zh: 本周财报前有很多担忧，Maribel，关于循环融资，这些超大规模云厂商、英伟达如何成为整个AI基础设施建设的金融参与者。我们现在应该对这些大交易有多担忧？

subtitles.en: Yeah, we are in this state where the revenue for the Frontier Model providers has not caught up with the spending that they had. The traditional capital markets would not do financing. So vendor financing is actually one of the best options that they have at this point, but it does lead into this.
subtitles.zh: 是的，我们处于前沿模型提供商的收入尚未赶上其支出的状态。传统资本市场不会提供融资，所以供应商融资实际上是他们目前最好的选择之一，但这确实导致了这个问题。

subtitles.en: If Nvidia says they're selling a lot of chips, but they're really vendor financing the chips to open AI, did they really make any money? So we do have a bit of a circular economy going on at this point in time, but it's not surprising.
subtitles.zh: 如果英伟达说他们卖了很多芯片，但实际上是通过供应商融资将芯片提供给OpenAI，他们真的赚钱了吗？所以目前确实存在一定的循环经济，但这并不令人意外。

subtitles.en: I think what we're all trying to figure out is this will be the most disruptive tech boom of our time, and the question is how fast and how broad is the monetization of that?
subtitles.zh: 我认为我们都在试图弄清楚的是，这将是当代最具颠覆性的科技繁荣，问题是变现的速度和广度如何？

subtitles.en: Because if you think about the companies that we've had in the past, we're looking at a whole different breed of companies being the companies of the future. Is it open AI? Is it anthropic? Will we continue to see someone like Microsoft who's been around for a significant period of time still be in that category, companies that's successful?
subtitles.zh: 因为如果你想想过去的公司，我们看到的未来公司将是完全不同的类型。是OpenAI？是Anthropic？我们是否会继续看到像微软这样存在已久的公司仍然属于成功公司的范畴？

subtitles.en: So these are the questions that people are asking, and what people are trying to figure out when they're investing is who will be the next company in the next 25, 30, 50 years?
subtitles.zh: 所以这些是人们正在问的问题，当人们配置资产时，他们试图弄清楚未来25年、30年、50年谁会是下一家公司？

subtitles.en: And Marital just quickly has the emergence of, I'll just use Kimi K3, but the emergence of these Chinese models, does that change that premise you just laid out there?
subtitles.zh: Maribel，快速问一下，像Kimi K3这样的中国模型的崛起，是否会改变你刚才提出的前提？

subtitles.en: I think there's been a tremendous discussion about how open-source models, the global model environment will impact the commercial revenue opportunity for the traditional foundation model providers. So I think we're in a state of tremendous innovation, tremendous opportunity for just wrapped across the globe. China's coming out to be quite a strong player in AI right now, and I think everybody is a bit concerned about what that will do to the U.S. economy.
subtitles.zh: 我认为关于开源模型、全球模型环境将如何影响传统基础模型提供商的商业收入机会，已经有了大量讨论。所以我认为我们正处于巨大的创新和机遇之中，遍及全球。中国在AI领域正成为相当强大的参与者，我认为每个人都有些担忧这对美国经济会有什么影响。

subtitles.en: Yeah, well, is there a lesson here to be, I think we ask that question every time we get a blow-up like this.
subtitles.zh: 是的，这里有没有什么教训？我想每次出现这种爆仓事件，我们都会问这个问题。

subtitles.en: At least this one was close to a blow-up. You mentioned Archegos there. What's the lesson here, David?
subtitles.zh: 至少这次是接近爆仓。你提到了Archegos。大卫，这里的教训是什么？

subtitles.en: I think there are a couple of key lessons. The first is that a lot of folks in finance can look down on hedge funds and say, look, these returns are fantastic.
subtitles.zh: 我认为有几个关键教训。首先，金融界的很多人会看不起对冲基金，说，看，这些回报很惊人。

subtitles.en: Sometimes it's trailing the markets, et cetera, et cetera. Hedge funds have gotten to where they are today, many of them, especially the multistrats, because they know how to take risk and they understand the nature of risk.
subtitles.zh: 有时是跑输市场等等。对冲基金能走到今天，尤其是多策略基金，是因为他们知道如何承担风险，理解风险的本质。

subtitles.en: It's not just that the stocks move up and down. It's also about your leverage. So I think the most important lesson here is that even if you are directionally right, you can be tactically wrong.
subtitles.zh: 不仅仅是权益资产涨跌，还关乎杠杆。所以我认为最重要的教训是，即使方向正确，战术上也可能出错。

subtitles.en: And you need to be prepared for the downside. In case of this, AI is a very, very volatile sector. Market sentiment is very volatile.
subtitles.zh: 你需要为下行做好准备。在这种情况下，AI是一个非常非常波动的板块，市场情绪非常不稳定。

subtitles.en: So on any given day, you might see huge ups and downs, Nvidia as a great example in the last few months, skyrocketing and then slumping badly.
subtitles.zh: 所以在任何一天，你可能会看到巨大的涨跌，英伟达就是过去几个月的好例子，暴涨然后暴跌。

subtitles.en: So if you made the wrong bets at the wrong time, you lost a lot of money. But the second key lesson, I think here, is for the banks themselves.
subtitles.zh: 所以如果你在错误的时间做了错误的押注，你会损失很多钱。但第二个关键教训，我认为是给银行本身的。

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
